intent: Select exactly one candidate id out of a list that code extracted from the source text: scan the text for candidate spans, then decide which candidate a stated policy identifies. The model only picks an id from the candidates the code produced - it never generates the value; the selected id is turned back into the real value by a capability. Route to a not-found node when no candidate is clearly identified, and carry the candidate list plus the picked value through.

known_steps.text: the workflow runs at most 6 iterations
a choice question "has_text" asks "Is there source text to scan?"
answer "B" when the field "text" contains "@" with hit 0.9
a choice question "billing_contact" asks "Which candidate email address is explicitly identified by text as the billing contact? Select none when the text does not establish exactly one."
the answer comes from the field "selected_id"

unknown_steps.text: a dynamic choice question "billing_contact" asks "Which one?"
the options are materialised from the state "candidates"
when no candidate is found go to "not_found"
